method: Short 12-simulated-second workloads (240 warm-up steps, approximately eight measured seconds), same-build ABBA aggregates; profile AB uses records after harness measurement marker with two completed windows discarded and CPU IDs aligned. Baseline disables ROOM_CACHE/DEPTH_KEEP/SHADER_VARIANTS; candidate enables them. Uniform cache changes are unconditional in both current arms. Cross group intentionally mixes previous/current builds.

invocation.unconditionalUniformCacheChanges: Present in current build in both same-build arms; cross build controls are intentionally mixed-MVID.
